events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) is retreating his arm into a vertical position and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs with Grant (POR) during his driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in Camara's (POR) path as he sets the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Grant (POR) is moving alongside Gordon's (DEN) path and the contact as they come together during the drive is marginal.  Gordon then loses control of the ball on his own.
Murray (DEN) brings his right hand up and makes clean contact with the ball as he defends Murray's (POR) shot near the rim.
Braun (DEN) applies his right forearm to Murray's (POR) upper body, and the contact during the shot near the rim is marginal.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms that any contact by Holiday (POR) during Gordon's (DEN) shot attempt is more than marginal.
Johnson (DEN) swipes his left arm down and initiates contact with Avdija's (POR) arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Braun (DEN) establishes himself in Camara's (POR) path and does not deliver contact during the pick.

Replay review of the foul called on Braun (DEN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Braun does not establish a legal guarding position in Grant's (POR) path prior to the contact, which affects his shot attempt.
Holiday (POR) is moving alongside Johnson's (DEN) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Camara (POR) cleanly blocks Johnson's (DEN) shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex.
Camara (POR) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Nuggets.
Camara (POR) cleanly ties up Jokic (DEN) and a jump ball is correctly called.
Sharpe (POR) cleanly blocks Gordon's (DEN) jump shot attempt.

Gordon (DEN) extends his right hand forward and makes contact with Grant's (POR) arm as he starts his upward shooting motion.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the foul occurred prior to the expiration of the game clock.
Grant (POR) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt.
